department: Department of Pure Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics

deadline.value: Funding deadline January 6, 2027 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: A proposed supervisor must be named; applications without a suitable prospective supervisor are likely to be rejected, though informal contact is not compulsory.
supervisor.quote: General and unfocused applications without a suitable prospective supervisor will be seriously disadvantaged or rejected.

funding.value: Department funding is considered but not guaranteed; applicants are expected to seek other funding too.
funding.quote: Receipt of this funding is not guaranteed and all applicants, irrespective of fee-status, are expected to apply to other funding schemes for which they are eligible.

entry_route.value: First-class honours after a four-year course, or a three-year degree plus a one-year postgraduate course in mathematics.
entry_route.quote: The usual minimum entry requirement is a first-class honours degree in mathematics or mathematics/statistics, awarded after a four-year course, or a three-year degree together with a one-year postgraduate course in those areas.

gre_subject.value: No GRE requirement listed on the course pages

notes: The Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics PhD (DAMTP) is a separate course with the same January 6, 2027 funding deadline.
